owner_authorisation: 2026-10-17 'Yes allow it' (STATE counterexample_hunt_strategy.owner_authorisations; PR #114), scope support-5 exhaustive only
earliest_activation: S110, only after S109 (this pre-registration and the Phase-2 gate extension) is committed on main and the code hashes below are re-verified
target: decide whether some zero-sumfree sequence over (Z/15)^3 with at most five distinct values has length >= 43 = 3n-2
search_domain: all free rank-2 direct summands K of (Z/n)^5 (relation modules of generating labelled 5-lists), up to S_5 coordinate permutation as specified per algorithm; for each K the exact maximum of sum(alpha) over alpha in [0,n-1]^5 with every nonzero rho in K escaping the box
symmetry_reductions_proved_and_used: CLM-0361 reduction to generating labelled lists / free rank-2 summands
CLM-0363 local graph form (A) / kernel form (B) and Gaussian count
CLM-0364 S_5 orbit representatives of one prime-power component

A.enumeration: S_5 reps of the smallest prime-power component x all K of the others

B.enumeration: all K of the smaller prime-power component x S_5 reps of the largest

budget.concurrency: at most 14 concurrent processes on 16 logical CPUs; order: CAM-0006 A+B, CAM-0007 B, CAM-0007 A

checkpoint_format: JSONL: AT_OR_ABOVE records (index, optimum, full K element list) for every K with optimum >= L; progress every 20000 evaluations (index, evaluated, max, elapsed); end record (pairs_evaluated, max_length, histogram of optima, orbits_at_or_above count+sha256, seconds)
coverage_check: sum of pairs_evaluated over the 14 shards must equal 791934 (A) and 349690 (B); any missing end record = shard TRUNCATED
stopping_rule: each shard runs to completion or is killed at the 43200 s cap by timeout (logged WALLTIME_CAP_TRUNCATED: no end record). Campaign COMPLETE only if all 14 shards of BOTH algorithms end with full coverage. Truncation makes the campaign PARTIAL and permits NO exclusion claim.
restart_procedure: deterministic enumeration; a crashed or truncated shard is re-run from the start with the same (shard, nshards); partial logs kept
on_hit: any K with optimum >= L: recover alpha and values, write candidates/<id>/sequence.json (canonical sorted triples + SHA-256), run checkers A and B standalone; CANDIDATE only; Lean 4 plan and later-session cold recheck before any certification; no external disclosure without owner authorisation
result_semantics: NEGATIVE result only if both algorithms complete with full coverage and max optimum <= 42: 'no zero-sumfree sequence over C_15^3 with at most five distinct values has length 43' (support-<=5 family only; NOT SAT15, NOT a D value). Certificate = committed shard end records + log hashes + two-algorithm agreement; Lean/DRAT certification not included.
code_sha256_note: SHA-256 of LF-normalised file bytes (git blob content); .gitattributes pins tools/zsf/*.py to eol=lf
